path_policy.source_relative_paths: Relative to the original private experiment root; not files promised to exist in this repository.
path_policy.raw_source_hashes: Hashes of original bytes measured/recorded by the cited audit; the original full result/RPC files are not published.
path_policy.export_hashes: Separate hashes in results/manifest.json refer to these derived CSV/JSON files.

verification_limits: This release rechecks cached numeric consistency and exports allowlisted fields; it does not make a new remote raw-artifact verification claim.
The early two-system snapshot uses recorded remote hash-match flags; later audits reverified the same result hashes.
No private configuration, host inventory, credential, browser/session file, model weights, activation tensor, dataset snapshot, or full RPC body is included.
model_revision_basis: Recorded on all audited B10 trajectories; B30 cached result projection retained profile_matches_registered=true rather than a duplicate revision field.
method_parameters_basis: Observed B10 actual_model_state_hash/selected_generation fields are base/G2 consistently; new-budget audit checked exact sealed execution_profile equality.

execution_source_applicability.all30_frozen_made_all30_runner.py: The50 new all30 B10 extension jobs. It is not asserted to have executed the original two/five-system jobs.
execution_source_applicability.sweep_frozen_made_budget_runner.py: New B30/B50 sweep jobs only. It is not asserted to have executed any B10 historical job.
execution_source_applicability.original_core_and_five_system_jobs: Their original scope fingerprints and raw result hashes remain authoritative; later inclusion does not relabel their executing source.

original_core_recorded_formula_source.basis: Explicitly preserved in the original cache-only audit; not inferred from the later published code.
